questions.q: What does the author say about the design of the A56 compared with other Samsung models?
o: It looks nothing like the others
It is almost identical to the other models
questions.e: In the video: "Dizajn modela A56 je skoro pa identičan kao i kod ostalih modela Samsunga" — the design of the A56 is almost identical to the other Samsung models.

questions.q: What are the back panel and frame made of?
o: The back panel is glass, the frame is metal
questions.e: In the video: "Leđa su staklena, a ivica metalna" — the back is glass, and the edge is metal.

questions.q: What does the author criticize about the screen?
o: A too-thick bezel around the screen
The lack of a 120 Hz rate
questions.e: In the video: "okvir oko ekrana koji je mogao da bude i manji" — a bezel around the screen that could have been smaller.

questions.q: What water and dust protection standard does the phone have?
questions.e: In the video: "Otpornost na vodu i prašinu je u okviru standarda IP67" — water and dust resistance is within the IP67 standard.

questions.q: What does the author call the main complaint about the camera?
questions.e: In the video: "nema telefoto objektiv, što je i najveća zamerka" — there is no telephoto lens, which is the biggest complaint.

questions.q: What did the author dislike when first turning it on?
o: The phone took long to activate and downloaded many updates
It wouldn't turn on at all
questions.e: In the video: "automatski je počeo da preuzima 130 GB ažuriranja za razne aplikacije" — it automatically started downloading 130 GB of updates for various apps.

questions.q: What comes in the box with the phone?
o: Only the phone, with no charger, case or screen film
questions.e: In the video: "uz telefon ne dobijate punjač, maskicu, pa čak ni zaštitnu foliju na staklu" — with the phone you don't get a charger, a case, or even a screen protector film on the glass.

questions.q: How much does the 256 GB version cost?
questions.e: In the video: "59.999 dinara za verziju sa 256 GB memorije" — 59,999 dinars for the version with 256 GB of memory.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Kamera nudi *oštre* fotografije u zatvorenom prostoru.
questions.e: Oštar — sharp, crisp.

questions.q: Telefon ima ravan *ekran*.
questions.e: Ekran — a screen.

questions.q: Podržano je brzo *punjenje* od 45 W.
questions.e: Punjenje — charging (a battery).

questions.q: Samsung ima dobar *operativni* sistem.
questions.e: Operativni sistem — an operating system.

questions.q: Dobijate lepe *kadrove* u 99% slučajeva.
questions.e: Kadar — a frame, a shot.

questions.q: Čipset ima 8 *jezgara*.
questions.e: Jezgro — a core.

questions.q: Telefon je zaštićen *staklom* Gorilla Glass Victus.
questions.e: Staklo — glass.

questions.q: Ekran ima 120 Hz *osvežavanja*.
questions.e: Osvežavanje — refreshing (of a screen).

questions.q: Telefon ima ekran od 6,7 ___.
questions.e: After a number of 5+, the genitive plural: 6,7 inča (inches).

questions.q: Leđa su staklena, a ivica ___.
questions.e: Ivica — feminine: metalna ivica.

questions.q: U ___ klasi Samsung je mogao da napravi manji okvir.
questions.e: U + locative case, feminine: u ovoj klasi.

questions.q: Samsung je unapredio ekran u odnosu na ___ godinu.
questions.e: U odnosu na + accusative case: na prošlu godinu.

questions.q: Kamera nije na nivou S ___.
questions.e: Na nivou + genitive case: na nivou S serije.

questions.q: Telefon radi brzo i ___.
questions.e: Adverb: radi stabilno — "works stably".

questions.q: Za većinu ___ ovo je odlična kupovina.
questions.e: Za većinu + genitive plural: korisnika.

questions.q: Možete ceo dan da ga koristite i nećete ga ___.
questions.e: Ne... + da/future: nećete ga isprazniti — "you won't drain it".
